purpose: Isolate the cause of the ~2 GB peak build RSS recorded in ticket 0011.
method: Rebuild the full library changing exactly one variable: ZOTEUS_INDEX_FULLTEXT_MAX_CHARS from 0 (uncapped) to 2000000. The next-largest .zotero-ft-cache is 1 908 743 B, so this truncates exactly one document -- DH8EXSVA, 44 906 152 chars -- and leaves every other document untouched.

result.note: The 41 048 lost passages are almost entirely the one dictionary beyond 2M chars. Peak RSS falls 5.2x. The ~2 GB peak is that single document, not a generic property of the page loop.

redaction: Document names removed 2026-08-31 by ruling (spec/DECISIONS.md): committed artifacts identify a library document by its Zotero item key and never by its title or filename. Keys are unchanged, so every figure here remains traceable.
